candidates.title: A Tool Connection Is Not Yet a Reusable Capability
candidates.title_zh: 工具能接上，不等于能力可复用
candidates.researchQuestion: 当智能体或数字员工把多个工具组合成可复用能力图时，什么证据足以把输出到输入的绑定视为可操作能力，而成功执行仍然不能证明什么？
candidates.coreProposition: Reusable tool composition should be admitted through versioned, execution-grounded, provenance-bearing and refreshable evidence that preserves composition semantics; capability evidence remains separate from call-time authority.

sections.heading: A Plausible Edge Is Only a Candidate
sections.heading_zh: 看起来能连接，只是候选关系

sections.heading: Composition Semantics Belong to Capability Identity
sections.heading_zh: 组合语义属于能力身份

sections.heading: What the Evidence Packet Must Bind
sections.heading_zh: 能力证据包必须绑定什么

sections.heading: Capability Is Not Authorization
sections.heading_zh: 能力证明不是执行授权

sections.heading: One Success Is Too Small and Forever Is Too Long
sections.heading_zh: 一次成功太少，永久有效太久

evidenceClaims.claim: The execution success rate of the model-judged initial dependency skeleton is 50.2%, while the refined graph reaches 62.7%; later-pruned edges execute successfully only 14.8% of the time.
evidenceClaims.claim_zh: 研究报告，模型判断形成的初始依赖骨架执行成功率为 50.2%，收敛后的图达到 62.7%；后来被剪除的边仅有 14.8% 执行成功。

evidenceClaims.claim: Live trials can overturn high model priors, and the method distinguishes structural failures from environmental failures when updating edge confidence.
evidenceClaims.claim_zh: 研究报告，实时试验能够推翻较高的模型先验，并在更新边置信度时区分结构性失败与环境性失败。

evidenceClaims.claim: The study reports that 81.2% of chained calls consume multi-record outputs, requiring explicit composition semantics rather than a universal one-to-one interpretation.
evidenceClaims.claim_zh: 研究报告，81.2% 的链式调用消费多记录输出，因此需要明确组合语义，而不能统一解释为一对一连接。

evidenceClaims.claim: A retained edge is contextual, confidence-bearing evidence rather than a universally proven and timeless capability.
evidenceClaims.claim_zh: 本次分析观察到，保留的边是带上下文和置信度的证据，而不是已经普遍证明且永久有效的能力。

evidenceClaims.claim: Reusable capability admission should bind tool identities, composition semantics, environment, trial history, failure class and freshness while keeping call-time authorization separate.
evidenceClaims.claim_zh: 本文据此解释，可复用能力准入应绑定工具身份、组合语义、环境、试验历史、失败类别与新鲜度，同时将调用时授权保留为独立门禁。

communityEdition.rationale: The complete Research Center edition carries the full transferable argument; a separate community edition would not add a distinct professional angle.

candidates.title: A Finished Report Is Not Yet a Trustworthy Conclusion
candidates.title_zh: 报告做完了，不等于结论可信
candidates.researchQuestion: 当智能体能够操作工具、执行分析并生成完整研究成果时，在把它的结论接受为可信的组织知识之前，还需要哪些额外证据？
candidates.coreProposition: Execution competence and trustworthy evidentiary judgment are separate acceptance states; consequential knowledge work should require observed challenge evidence for controls, robustness, falsification and bounded generalization before a polished result becomes organizational authority.

sections.heading: Close Overall Scores Hide a Shared Weakness
sections.heading_zh: 总分接近，掩盖了共同短板

sections.heading: Auditability Is Not Challenge Evidence
sections.heading_zh: 可审计，不等于经过挑战

sections.heading: A Correct Run Can Support a Weak Conclusion
sections.heading_zh: 正确执行，也可能支撑薄弱结论

sections.heading: Challenge Depth Should Follow Consequence
sections.heading_zh: 挑战深度应随后果变化

sections.heading: An Evaluator Is Evidence, Not Ground Truth
sections.heading_zh: 评估器是证据，不是最终事实

evidenceClaims.claim: Four agent scaffolds using the same frozen base model achieve similar overall scores, with no statistically reliable corrected pairwise winner in the reported comparison.
evidenceClaims.claim_zh: 研究报告，四种智能体脚手架在使用同一冻结基础模型时总分接近，校正后的成对比较没有统计可靠的赢家。

evidenceClaims.claim: Evidence Auditability and Novelty are comparatively strong while Control Testing, Robustness and Falsifiability are substantially weaker across scaffolds.
evidenceClaims.claim_zh: 研究报告，不同脚手架的证据可审计性和新颖性相对较强，而对照测试、稳健性和可证伪性明显较弱。

evidenceClaims.claim: The evaluator awards no credit to proposed-but-not-executed checks, separating stated intent from observed evidence-producing work.
evidenceClaims.claim_zh: 研究报告，评估器不会为仅提出但未执行的检查计分，从而把陈述意图与真正产生证据的工作分开。

evidenceClaims.claim: A technically successful run can demonstrate execution competence without showing that its conclusion survived plausible alternatives or perturbations.
evidenceClaims.claim_zh: 本次分析观察到，技术上成功的运行可以证明执行能力，却不能证明结论经受住合理替代解释或扰动。

evidenceClaims.claim: Consequential knowledge work should preserve separate acceptance states for execution competence and evidentiary judgment, requiring challenge evidence before organizational adoption.
evidenceClaims.claim_zh: 本文据此解释，高后果知识工作应分别保存执行能力与证据判断的准入状态，并在组织采用前要求挑战证据。
